description: Source code implementing server-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol functions, including server initialization, key generation, key retrieval, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes server state with user credentials and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates server's ephemeral public value B based on private b and other parameters.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes session key based on client input and server's stored values.

methods.name: t_serververify
methods.description: Verifies client's response against expected values to authenticate session.

methods.name: t_serverresponse
methods.description: Returns the server's session response for client verification.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Cleans up server state and frees allocated memory.
